title: King Charles May Offer Harry Buckingham Palace Room Despite William's Concerns - NewsBreak
text:
By Newslooks Morning Edition J.Mansour ,
9 hours ago King Charles May Offer Harry Buckingham Palace Room Despite William’s Concerns/ Newslooks/ WASHINGTON/ J. Mansour/ King Charles reportedly plans to offer Prince Harry a room at Buckingham Palace when the Duke of Sussex returns to Britain in September. Royal commentators interpret the potential invitation as evidence that Charles favors reconciliation while Prince William maintains strict boundaries with his estranged brother. Neither Buckingham Palace nor Kensington Palace confirmed reports of disagreements between the king and his heir. Read full article
